lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Irregularly spaced high-luminance circular clusters arranged in quasi-vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, decreasing in diameter toward the dorsal ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of spots, creating a grid-like distribution pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel horizontal ridges on the upper flank exhibiting a distinct vertical luminance gradient with a highlight on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate density of small, high-luminance circular blobs distributed relatively evenly across the surface of the visible pectoral and dorsal fin silhouettes.
